description: Source code for the CalendarActivity class in SuiteCRM, handling calendar events, free/busy activities, and related database queries.

classes.name: CalendarActivity
classes.description: Represents calendar activities, including tasks, meetings, and free/busy slots, with methods for querying and filtering activities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CalendarActivity object based on provided arguments, handling tasks, other beans, or free/busy slots.

methods.name: get_occurs_within_where_clause
methods.description: Returns SQL WHERE clause for activities occurring within a specified time range.

methods.name: get_occurs_until_where_clause
methods.description: Returns SQL WHERE clause for activities occurring until a specified time.

methods.name: get_freebusy_activities
methods.description: Retrieves free/busy activities for a user within a time range from vCal data.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Fetches activities (tasks, calls, meetings) for a user within a specified time window, applying filters and security checks.

methods.name: getOccursWhereClauseGeneral
methods.description: Generates a general SQL WHERE clause for activity date ranges, used by specific occurrence methods.

methods.name: within
methods.description: Helper to generate SQL clause for activities within a date range.

methods.name: until
methods.description: Helper to generate SQL clause for activities until a date, including overlapping activities.
